queries_run: Fortinet China ban US cybersecurity products 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：公司目前不預期關稅對原料與產品進口成本有重大影響，但若美國擴大關稅或他國報復，產品成本可能上升、需漲價。
findings.excerpt: While we do not currently expect tariffs to have a significant effect on our raw material and product import costs, if the United States expands increased tariffs, changes in customs or tariffs classifications or modifications to tariff exemptions or if retaliatory trade measures are taken by other countries in response to the U.S. tariffs, the cost of our products could increase

findings.claim: 10-K：產品含加密技術，受美國出口管制，部分產品需出口許可或可能被禁止出口至特定國家。
findings.excerpt: Because we incorporate encryption technology into our products, certain of our products are subject to U.S. export controls and may be exported outside the United States only with the required export license or through an export license exception, or may be prohibited altogether from export to certain countries.

findings.claim: 10-K：中國政府近期指示國內特定產業企業不得使用包含公司在內的美國或以色列資安產品。
findings.excerpt: the Chinese government recently instructed domestic companies in certain industries not to use cybersecurity products manufactured by the companies 47 Table of Contents based in the United States or Israel, including us and certain of our competitors.

findings.claim: 路透報導北京要求中國企業停用包含 Fortinet 在內的十餘家美國／以色列資安廠商產品，限 2026 上半年前替換。
findings.excerpt: The US companies whose cybersecurity software has been banned include Broadcom-owned VMware, Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet, while the Israeli companies include Check Point Software Technologies, the sources said.

note: Section 232 搜尋查無 Fortinet 專屬資料（半導體 232 關稅 2026-01-15 生效是否涵蓋其設備未證實）。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
